# Umbra OS

> Invisible AI computer assistant for Windows. Local-first Node.js/TypeScript backend with a React + Electron desktop client. Controls a real or virtual Windows desktop via CDP, runs an LLM agent loop (plan → act → observe → verify), and exposes a REST + WebSocket API on port 8787.

## Core Documentation

- [README.md](/README.md) — Project overview, quick start, project structure
- [Backend README](backend/README.md) — Detailed architecture, ports, scripts, docs
- [Desktop README](desktop/README.md) — Desktop app setup, features, important file notes
- [UI Contract](backend/docs/ui-contract.md) — REST API + WebSocket contract for the read-only UI
- [Cloud Setup](backend/docs/cloud-setup.md) — Zero-cost cloud provisioning with Hetzner + Stripe
- [Cloud Deployment](backend/docs/cloud-deploy.md) — Headless mode, device mesh, billing, connectors
- [Virtual Display](backend/docs/virtual-display.md) — IDDCX kernel driver for virtual monitors
- [Voicebox Setup](backend/docs/voicebox-setup.md) — Local cloned-voice TTS setup guide

## Architecture

```
umbra-os/
├── backend/          # Node.js/TypeScript backend (API server, AI, voice, P2P, MCP, etc.)
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── index.ts        # UmbraOS composition root
│   │   ├── api/            # REST + WebSocket API (port 8787)
│   │   ├── core/           # Agent, browser, voice, memory, vault, privacy, audio...
│   │   ├── native/         # Windows native modules (input, screen capture, HWID)
│   │   ├── knowledge/      # Knowledge graph, journal, recall
│   │   ├── mobile/         # PWA server, preview streamer
│   │   ├── overlay/        # Command HUD, global hotkeys
│   │   ├── p2p/            # Mesh, pairing, WebRTC
│   │   └── config/         # ConfigManager + config schema
│   └── mesh/               # Rust P2P core (zero-knowledge, encrypted)
├── desktop/            # React 19 + Vite 8 + Electron 43 desktop app
└── package.json        # Root workspace scripts
```

## Key Features

- **AI Agent Loop** — Submit tasks via `POST /api/task`; the agent plans (LLM), acts on Desktop 2 via CDP, observes (DOM snapshot + screenshot), verifies (VLM), and self-heals on failure.
- **Screen Reading & Recall** — OCR of the active screen via Tesseract, activity sessions, privacy-filtered before storage into a vector memory.
- **Knowledge Brain** — Recall events bridged into a knowledge graph every 15 minutes; hourly auto-journaling + topic indexing.
- **Virtual Desktop Infrastructure** — Dedicated Windows virtual desktop for the agent; optional Docker worker containers with resource limits.
- **Consent Gate** — Session-grant for input actions; `~/.umbra/emergency-stop` file aborts tasks and blocks all actions.
- **Voice Stack** — Local STT/TTS/ASR via VibeVoice, whisper.cpp, Piper TTS, Voicebox; push-to-talk hotkey, meeting transcription with speaker diatomization.
- **Meeting Companion** — Attend meetings end-to-end: agenda planning, live digest, action items, mute/raise-hand/share controls.
- **MCP Registry** — Model Context Protocol dispatch for 1000+ connectors over HTTP, native bindings, or prompts; vault-backed credentials.
- **P2P Mesh & Device Pairing** — Encrypted Rust mesh daemon + WebSocket device hub; QR-code pairing, WebRTC streaming, bundled PWA for phone control.
- **Skill Stack & Context Compression** — 20 domains × 5 skills (100 skills); Graphify/Caveman pipeline compresses ~10K tokens → ~300.
- **Metering & Prompt Caching** — Every LLM call gated behind plan tier, circuit breaker, token accounting; prompt caching to cut repeat costs.
- **Billing & Cloud Provisioning** — Stripe checkout + webhook auto-activates Pro/Ultimate plans; Hetzner VPS provisioned on payment, destroyed on cancel.
- **Telco (SMS & Calls)** — Send SMS or initiate voice calls via Telnyx from the REST API.

## Tech Stack

- **Runtime**: Node.js, TypeScript (CommonJS)
- **API**: Native `http` module, REST + WebSocket (`/api/ws`), JSON-RPC (`/mcp`)
- **Validation**: Zod
- **LLM**: Ollama (local default), OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter (cloud)
- **Database**: SQLite (`better-sqlite3`), `sql.js`, vector search (`sqlite-vec`)
- **Auth**: Supabase (web app), CredentialVault (AES-256-GCM, HWID+DPAPI bound)
- **Desktop**: React 19, Vite 8, Electron 43, Tailwind CSS, Zustand
- **P2P**: WebRTC, Rust mesh daemon (MeshBridge)
- **Voice**: VibeVoice, whisper.cpp, Piper TTS, Voicebox, faster-whisper
- **Testing**: Jest (backend, 562 tests / 62 suites), Vitest (desktop)
- **Lint**: oxlint
- **Container**: Docker + docker compose (cloud deployment, whisper STT)
- **Cloud**: Hetzner VPS provisioning, Caddy (TLS), coturn (TURN relay)
- **Billing**: Stripe
- **Telco**: Telnyx
- **Mesh**: Rust (Cargo workspace), zero-knowledge identity

## API Endpoints

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8787` (bound to loopback only by default). CORS: `*` on every response.

### Status & Health
| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/health` | Liveness: `{ ok: true, uptimeMs }` |
| GET | `/api/status` | Full snapshot: consent, desktop2, agent, swarm, models, memory, vault |

### Tasks
| Method | Path | Body | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/api/task` | `{ description, priority?, idempotencyKey? }` | Submit a task → `{ taskId }` |
| GET | `/api/task/:id` | — | Full task incl. status, steps, result |
| GET | `/api/tasks` | — | Active tasks |
| POST | `/api/agent/delegate` | `{ description, provider?, model?, timeoutMs? }` | Delegate a task to Hermes |
| GET | `/api/task-queue/export` | — | Export task queue JSON |
| POST | `/api/task-queue/import` | `{ files? }` | Import + resume task queue |
| POST | `/api/shutdown` | — | Graceful shutdown |

### Desktop 2 Control (consent-gated)
| Method | Path | Body | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/api/desktop2/action` | `{ action, params? }` | Execute a Desktop 2 action |
| POST | `/api/ghost/action` | `{ action, params? }` | Execute a ghost (real desktop) action |
| GET | `/api/ghost/capture` | — | Capture a screenshot from Desktop 2 |
| GET | `/api/screen/state` | — | Current screen state |
| GET | `/api/screen/live` | — | Live screen frame |
| POST | `/api/screen/watch` | `{ enabled }` | Start/stop screen watching |
| POST | `/api/screen/ask` | `{ question, intent? }` | Ask about the screen |

### Consent & Emergency Stop
| Method | Path | Body | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/consent` | — | Consent + emergency-stop state |
| POST | `/api/consent` | `{ action: "request", reason }` | Request consent (y/n prompt) |
| POST | `/api/consent` | `{ action: "arm" }` | Arm emergency stop |
| POST | `/api/consent` | `{ action: "disarm" }` | Disarm emergency stop |

### Knowledge & Memory
| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/knowledge/search?q=` | Knowledge graph search |
| GET | `/api/memory/recall?q=` | Vector memory recall |
| POST | `/api/memory/remember` | `{ text }` | Store text in memory |
| GET | `/api/macros` | Detected macros |
| GET | `/api/sessions` | Activity sessions |
| GET | `/api/privacy/stats` | Privacy stats |
| GET | `/api/activity/summary` | Recall activity summary |
| GET | `/api/swarm` | Swarm status |
| GET | `/api/vault/stats` | Audit vault stats |
| GET | `/api/repos` | Repository list |
| POST | `/api/journal/generate` | Force journal generation |

### Worker Management (actions requiring review)
| Method | Path | Body | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/api/actions/propose` | `{ taskId, action, args }` | Propose an action for review |
| POST | `/api/actions/review` | `{ proposalId, approved, hash }` | Review a proposal |
| GET | `/api/actions/proposal/:id` | — | Get a proposal |
| GET | `/api/task/:id/proposals` | — | List proposals for a task |
| POST | `/api/task/:id/input` | `{ question, options? }` | Request input from user |
| POST | `/api/input/:inputId/answer` | `{ taskId, answer }` | Submit input answer |

### Worker Leasing (distributed execution)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| POST | `/api/worker/heartbeat` | `{ taskId, workerId }` | Heartbeat |
| POST | `/api/worker/release` | `{ taskId, workerId }` | Release lease |
| POST | `/api/worker/recover` | `{ workerId }` | Recover orphaned leases |

| POST | `/api/mcp/sync` | `{ maxPerSource? }` | Sync external connectors |
| POST | `/mcp` | JSON-RPC | MCP JSON-RPC endpoint |
| GET | `/api/mcp/oauth/callback?code=&state=` | OAuth callback |
| GET | `/api/mcp/oauth/status?id=` | OAuth status |
| POST | `/api/mcp/oauth/start` | `{ id, redirectUri? }` | Start OAuth |
| POST | `/api/mcp/oauth/refresh` | `{ id }` | Refresh OAuth token |
| GET | `/api/connectors` | List connectors |
| GET | `/api/connectors/categories` | Connector categories |
| GET | `/api/connectors/search?q=` | Search connectors |
| GET | `/api/connectors/:id` | Get connector |

| GET | `/api/connectors/:id/status` | Connection status |
| GET | `/api/connectors/:id/readiness` | What the user must do to connect it |
| GET | `/api/connectors/readiness` | Readiness for every catalog entry + counts |
| GET | `/api/connectors/:id/tools` | Stored tool schemas for one connector |
| GET | `/api/connectors/tools/schemas?q=&connectorId=&limit=&offset=` | Schema browser |
| POST | `/api/connectors/:id/ensure-tools` | `{ force? }` | One-click enable: ingest known spec when tools missing (idempotent) |
| POST | `/api/connectors/ingest-openapi` | `{ connectorId, spec?/specUrl?, baseUrl?, authType?, apiKeyHeader?, replace?, maxTools? }` | Ingest OpenAPI spec |
| POST | `/api/connectors/:id/disconnect` | Disconnect |
| POST | `/api/connectors/execute` | `{ connectorId, endpoint, method, payload?, userId? }` | Execute action |
| POST | `/api/connectors/tools` | `{ query, limit? }` | Relevant tools for query |
| POST | `/api/connectors/sync` | Sync catalog |
| POST | `/api/connectors/credential` | `{ slug, clientId, clientSecret, scopes }` | Save dev credentials |

### WebSocket API
- `ws://127.0.0.1:8787/api/ws` — Subscribe to status snapshots and live events (task lifecycle, swarm, recall, audio, overlay, etc.)
- `ws://127.0.0.1:9090` — Live preview stream of Desktop 2 (frames + commands, consent-gated)

## Configuration

Configuration lives in `~/.umbra/config.json` (created on first boot with defaults). Key sections:

| Section | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `provider` | LLM provider: `ollama` \| `openai` \| `anthropic` \| `openai-compatible` |
| `models` | Model slots: `provider`, `reasoning`, `vision`, `fast`, `embedding?` |
| `paths` | Data dir, knowledge dir, recall DB, vault dir, logs dir |
| `plan` | `tier` (free/pro/ultimate), token budgets, routing config |
| `workspace` | Max virtual displays, dimensions, FPS, CPU/GPU limits |
| `p2p` | Web/signaling ports, STUN/TURN servers, mesh daemon toggle |
| `devices` | Device hub port, remote hub URL, device name and role |
| `mcp` | MCP registry toggles, connector configs, OAuth clients |
| `voice` | STT/TTS/ASR provider settings (VibeVoice, whisper, Piper, Voicebox) |
| `meeting` | Meeting STT/TTS, loopback, audio cable, native app control |
| `billing` | Stripe keys, webhook secret, price IDs (git-ignored) |
| `cloud` | Hetzner API token, SSH key, VPS image, public URL |
| `telco` | Telnyx provider, from-number, messaging profile |
| `docker` | Docker socket path, default CPU/memory limits |
| `image` | Image generation provider (HuggingFace/Replicate) |
| `graphify` | Context compression settings (max tokens, chunk size, summary tokens) |
| `compiler` | Skill compilation backend (node/tcc/clang) |
| `shadow` | Live shadow recording (DXGI/GDI, FPS) |
| `hermes` | External agent engine config (binary path, timeout, auto-delegate) |
| `smartthings` | Samsung SmartThings PAT and API URL |
| `smartHome` | Per-platform pre-seeded credentials (e.g. `smartHome.homeassistant = { url, token }`) |
| env `UMBRA_SMARTTHINGS_CLIENT_ID` / `_CLIENT_SECRET` | Enable "Sign in with Samsung SmartThings". Without them the card falls back to a pasted PAT |
| env `UMBRA_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` + `UMBRA_GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID` | Enable "Sign in with Google Home" via the Smart Device Management API (Google devices only — thermostats, cameras, doorbells, displays). OAuth-only; there is no Google PAT. |
| `hotkeys` | Overlay, pause, toggle-preview key combos |
| `hotkeys` | Overlay, pause, toggle-preview key combos |
| `realDesktop` | Chrome path, CDP port, window dimensions for real desktop control |
| `audio` | Audio enabled, gesture cooldown |
| `logging` | Log level, pretty-print |
| `repos` | Repository configs for the GitHub issue watcher |
| `github` | GitHub watcher: repos, poll interval, labels, consent |

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `UMBRA_ROLE` | `desktop` (default) or `cloud` — cloud disables Windows-native subsystems |
| `UMBRA_HEADLESS` | `1` — disables screen reader, preview streamer, HUD, P2P/PWA |
| `UMBRA_BIND_HOST` / `UMBRA_HOST` | Override API bind address (default `127.0.0.1`) |
| `UMBRA_LLM_PROVIDER` | Boot override for LLM provider (`ollama`/`openai`/`anthropic`/`openai-compatible`/`none`) |
| `UMBRA_CONSENT_AUTOGRANT` | `1` — skip all consent prompts |
| `UMBRA_SMARTTHINGS_TOKEN` | SmartThings PAT |
| `UMBRA_HA_URL` | Home Assistant server URL |
| `UMBRA_HUBITAT_URL` / `UMBRA_HUBITAT_APP_ID` | Hubitat hub URL + Maker API app id |
| `UMBRA_OPENHAB_URL` | openHAB REST server URL |
| `UMBRA_TUYA_ENDPOINT` | Tuya IoT regional endpoint (e.g. `https://openapi.tuyaus.com`) |
| `UMBRA_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | Stripe secret key |
| `UMBRA_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Stripe webhook signing secret |
| `UMBRA_PUBLIC_URL` | Public base URL for QR/join links |
| `HERMES_BIN` | Path to Hermes CLI binary |
| `HERMES_HOME` | Hermes home directory |
| `HERMES_ACCEPT_HOOKS` | Accept hooks from Hermes |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | OpenRouter API key |

## Ports (all loopback by default)

| Port | Service |
| --- | --- |
| 8787 | REST API + event WebSocket (`/api/ws`) |
| 8788 | DeviceHub WebSocket (device mesh) |
| 9090 | Live preview stream of Desktop 2 |
| 9222 | Edge/Chrome CDP (Desktop 2 browser) |
| 9224 | Real Chrome CDP (human desktop) |

## Contributing

1. Read [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — full project documentation
2. Clone the repo and install:
   ```bash
   cd backend && npm install
   cd ../desktop && npm install
   ```
3. Run in development:
   ```bash
   cd .. && npm run dev
   ```
4. Run linting:
   ```bash
   npm run lint
   ```
5. Run tests:
   ```bash
   npm test              # backend Jest (562 tests / 62 suites)
   cd desktop && npm run test   # desktop Vitest
   ```
6. Build for production:
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```

## Running Locally

- **Backend dev mode**: `cd backend && npm run dev` (ts-node, port 8787)
- **Backend production**: `cd backend && npm run build && npm start`
- **Desktop dev**: `cd desktop && npm run desktop` (Vite + Electron)
- **Desktop production**: `cd desktop && npm run build && npm run desktop:pack`
- **Docker (cloud)**: `docker compose up -d`
- **Docker (cloud + edge)**: `UMBRA_DOMAIN=umbra.example.com docker compose --profile edge up -d`
